function: Attention-based SAC agent sets STARS transmit/reflect beamforming and user power allocation; second SAC agent flies the UAV; objective is user SINR and sensing CRB (pp. 6-8).
system: UAV with 8 antennas; energy-splitting STARS (simultaneous transmit and reflect) with 12 elements and 5 sensors; 1-4 users; 28 GHz only in wideband test (pp. 3, 10, 12).
method: Deep reinforcement learning: soft actor-critic with attention-based actor (A2) for STARS beamforming and power, plus a second SAC agent for UAV flight; replay-buffer training (pp. 7-9).
data_channel: Custom simulator: Rician fading for UAV-STARS and STARS-user channels (Rician factor 10, path-loss exponent 2.2); wideband test with 4 taps; no dataset or measurement (pp. 4, 10, 12).
test_conditions: Trained with K=1 user, tested with K=2, K=4 and with users joining during flight; other methods use models trained for each K; wideband system also simulated (pp. 11-12).
baselines: Non-learned: random action scheme (RAS). Learned: SAC, decoupled SAC (DeSAC), DDPG, TDDPG, SD3 (pp. 9, 11).
metrics: Mean episode reward, cumulative ISAC performance (user SINR and sensing CRB of 2D DOA), UAV distance to destination, FLOPs and parameters (pp. 10-12).
complexity: Time and space complexity orders; Table II: AT-DS 583.616 K FLOPs and 454.03 K parameters (pp. 9-10).
q1_support: p. 4: "as Rician fading channels"; custom Rician model, and no 3GPP TR 38.901, QuaDRiGa, DeepMIMO or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 11: "we utilize the model trained in the scenario with K = 1"; it is tested with K = 2 and K = 4 (Fig. 6) and with users joining during flight (Fig. 9).
q3_support: p. 9: "Random Action Scheme (RAS)" is the non-learned baseline; p. 9: "Deep deterministic policy gradient (DDPG) [55]" is an earlier learned method; p. 11: "TDDPG [56], and RAS in terms of ISAC performance".
q4_support: p. 10: "assessed using floating-point operations (FLOPs)"; Table II lists AT-DS at 583.616 K computations and 454.03 K memory; p. 9 gives the complexity orders.
q5_support: p. 10: "Windows platform using PyTorch 2.0.1 and Python 3.9.16"; no code or data link is given, and the channels are simulated, not a public dataset.
notes: Area 6 chosen over 5 and 3 by the tie-break order: aerial UAV link with learned power and beam control that also senses. Tables I and II read from the page image of p. 10. The K=1 model is reused for K=2 and K=4 (p. 11). Wideband test (p. 12) does not say whether the agent was retrained, so it is not counted for q2.
